t: The Articulate Ape in the Age of AI: From Grunts to Python Actuation
s: The article traces humanity's adaptive journey from early articulation (grunts, tool-making) to modern programming (Python) as a continuous drive to exert will on reality and maintain agency in an AI-dominated world. It explores this lineage through evolutionary theories, historical critiques, and a call for pragmatic optimism.
sub: Humanity's Evolutionary Arc: From Grunts to Python Actuation
The 'Articulate Ape' Hypothesis & Rapid Language Selection
AI's Impact on Agency and Modern Societal Isolation
Optimism as a Scientific Principle for Human Adaptation
Pipulate Project: Coding as Antidote to 'Bowling Alone'
